title: Shared workspace move
summary: [00:00-00:36] Workspace trial — Participant A proposes a one-week trial in the east workspace to see how well it supports the team’s work and confirms that the current room will remain available during the trial • [00:36-01:05] Equipment readiness — Participant C reports that six desks are equipped, with two more monitors still expected • [01:05-01:43] Capacity & calls — Participant B proposes a shared booking schedule for the enclosed call room; Participant D suggests collecting attendance information to help manage capacity • [01:43-02:21] Start decision — Participant A proposes starting Monday, subject to network and docking checks on Thursday, and will confirm whether to proceed on Friday afternoon • [02:21-03:04] Preparation owners — Participant B will prepare an arrival guide, Participant C will check equipment details, and Participant D will gather intended attendance • [03:04-03:39] Setup & feedback — Participant B raises storage and practical setup requests; Participant D discusses collecting feedback after the trial • [03:39-04:02] Longer-term arrangements — Participant A confirms that longer-term seating and use of the rooms will be considered later
